The papers mention Argonne's BatPaC battery cost model in the following:

1. "Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Cathodes – A Prospective Solution to the Battery Industry's Cobalt Problem" (page 2) - The authors used the BatPaC model to estimate the amount of cobalt required for each cathode class.
2. "Energy and environmental aspects in recycling lithium-ion batteries: Concept of Battery Identity Global Passport" (page 2) - The authors used the BatPaC model to estimate the cost of recycling LIBs.
3. "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries" (page 2) - The authors used the BatPaC model to estimate the cost of electrode and cell manufacturing.
4. "Sustainable recycling of cathode scraps via Cyrene-based separation" (not mentioned)
